description: This file contains the implementation of the AttributeGroup class within the OpenCart admin model for catalog attributes, including methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving attribute group data and descriptions.

classes.name: AttributeGroup
classes.description: Represents a model for managing attribute groups in the OpenCart catalog, including CRUD operations for attribute group data and descriptions.

methods.name: addAttributeGroup
methods.description: Adds a new attribute group to the database with provided data, including descriptions for multiple languages.

methods.name: editAttributeGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing attribute group identified by its ID with new data and descriptions.

methods.name: deleteAttributeGroup
methods.description: Removes an attribute group and its descriptions from the database by ID.

methods.name: getAttributeGroup
methods.description: Retrieves data of a specific attribute group by its ID.

methods.name: getAttributeGroups
methods.description: Fetches a list of attribute groups with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAttributeGroups
methods.description: Returns the total number of attribute groups in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an attribute group in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions related to a specific attribute group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all attribute group descriptions associated with a particular language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific attribute group across multiple languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches descriptions for all attribute groups in a specific language.
